name: TechBucket
tagline: A Nepal-based software company building modern, reliable technology for healthcare and beyond since 2019.

hero.title: Powering Healthcare Through Technology
hero.subtitle: We build modern, reliable software and infrastructure solutions for healthcare providers and other industries across Nepal. Trusted by clinics, hospitals and health organisations across the Kathmandu Valley.

about.title: Software That Transforms How You Work
paragraphs: TechBucket Pvt. Ltd. is a Nepal-based software and IT company. We design, build, and maintain digital solutions that improve patient outcomes, streamline clinical workflows, and empower organisations to deliver better care and services.

Founded in 2019, we started in healthcare IT and have expanded into infrastructure and other industries — growing from a small startup to a trusted partner for hospitals, clinics, health startups and enterprises across Nepal.

trustPoints.title: Healthcare Focused
trustPoints.description: Every solution is built around real clinical workflows.

trustPoints.title: Nepal Based
trustPoints.description: A local team that understands the local health system.

trustPoints.title: Data Privacy Secure
trustPoints.description: Encrypted storage and strict access controls by default.

trustPoints.title: Milestone-Based Projects
trustPoints.description: Transparent delivery with clearly defined milestones.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To democratise healthcare technology in Nepal by delivering affordable, scalable and reliable digital solutions that empower healthcare providers to focus on what matters most — patient care. We believe every clinic, from Kathmandu to the remote hills, deserves world-class software.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To be the most trusted healthcare technology partner in South Asia — building a future where every healthcare worker has access to digital tools that are as powerful as they are intuitive, enabling Nepal's healthcare system to reach its full potential.

values.title: Innovation
values.body: We push the boundaries of healthcare technology with creative solutions that solve real-world clinical challenges.

values.title: Reliability
values.body: Healthcare never sleeps. Our systems are built for 99.9% uptime with rock-solid infrastructure and redundancy.

values.title: Compassion
values.body: Every line of code we write is in service of better patient outcomes and a healthier Nepal.

contact.heading: Let's Build Something Great Together
contact.subheading: Looking to build better software for your healthcare organisation? Write to us and our team will respond within 24 hours.

footer.blurb: Serving Nepal's healthcare sector with modern, reliable software since 2019.
